A '''camp''' was built by a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] party in the dangerous [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]], the dark ground level of the [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]-high forests of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It consisted of several rather primitive tents and huts made of wood and hides. The Gotal hunters used it as their base of operations during their hunt for the local wildlife.
